name: Rockfish Data
tagline: Reliable AI starts with the data behind your evals.
description: Rockfish Data generates the high-coverage synthetic data that AI evaluations need — realistic time-series datasets and aligned eval suites that surface how AI agents and models fail before customers do. The same platform powers both agent evaluation and ML stress-testing, generated from a schema or a sample of your own data, without exposing production data. Founded and led by Dr. MuckAI Girish, a Wharton Executive MBA alum, as CEO.

name: LotusAI
tagline: Grow with the power of generative & responsible AI.
description: LotusAI is a London-based AI advisory firm that helps leaders — from private equity and financial-services enterprises (including Goldman Sachs Asset Management and its portfolio companies) to digital-consulting firms and PE-backed ventures — adopt responsible, sustainable generative AI. Its work spans AI advisory, responsible-AI operationalization, AI due diligence, and talent transformation. Founded and led by Didem Ün Ateş (W'97), a Wharton undergraduate alumna and longtime AI executive, as CEO.

name: Civic
tagline: The operating system for modern government communications.
description: Civic builds the first AI-native platform for government communications, workflows, and analytics. Its Revere CRM helps offices from Capitol Hill to local city councils manage high-volume inboxes, track casework, and respond faster — with AI built for the compliance and scale of public service. Co-founded by Wharton alumni Jon Kokot (WG'25, CEO) and Julian Trajanson (W'12, CTO).

name: AndesML
tagline: The retail media platform — from LatAm to the world.
description: AndesML is a retail-media platform that helps retailers and marketplaces turn their traffic into a new, high-margin revenue stream. Its AI-driven, white-label product spans sponsored products, sponsored brands, and display ads — onsite, offsite, and in-store — with first-party-data monetization, built on the team's experience running two of Latin America's largest e-commerce businesses. Founded by Tomás Gazmuri, a Wharton MBA alum.

name: Chapter
tagline: Enterprise AI that goes from information to action.
description: Chapter deploys multi-agent AI for customer-facing teams in sales, service, and field operations — running inside a company's own private, airgapped infrastructure rather than on public models. Its agentic workflow engine, built-in sales roleplay coaching, and mobile-first learning are proven at enterprise scale, with 40,000+ users and 90%+ adoption across BFSI, insurance, and field-service deployments. Founded by Rohit Kumar (WG'95), a Wharton MBA alum and former Microsoft and Oracle executive, as Managing Director & Founder.

name: ficc.ai
tagline: Revolutionizing municipal bond pricing with AI.
description: ficc.ai is transforming evaluated pricing for municipal bonds, using AI developed in-house by a team of market experts and scientists to deliver real-time, trade-size-aware bid/ask prices for individual bonds, bid/offer lists, and entire portfolios — via web app, API, or custom integration — supporting pre-trade analysis, execution, and best-execution compliance reporting. Our Wharton connection is CTO Gil Shulman (Wharton MBA), previously of Microsoft AI and Amazon and founder of mobile-advertising pioneer Amobee; the firm is led by CEO Stephen Winterstein.

name: Qritive
description: Qritive builds AI-powered digital pathology solutions that help pathologists identify, grade, and classify cancer with speed and consistency. Its hardware-agnostic AI modules — spanning prostate and colon cancer, lymph node metastasis, and biomarker analysis — plug into existing workflows and into Pantheon™, Qritive's AI-powered pathology workbench and remote patient-management platform. Led by CEO Bruno Occhipinti, a Wharton MBA alum (WG'08).

name: HAI Clean
tagline: Infection intelligence for shared hospital equipment.
description: HAI Clean is a UK health-tech company developing a platform that helps hospitals see, verify, and manage contamination risk on shared portable medical equipment — through controlled disinfection workflows, audit-ready records, and secure operational analytics (HAI = healthcare-associated infections). Registered in Scotland, it is focused on development, validation, and partnerships across healthcare, academia, and industry. Its Wharton connection runs through alumnus and major investor Mark Tousey, and WAAIS founder George Gvishiani serves as a board advisor.

name: Fairbanc
tagline: AI-powered embedded credit for underserved small businesses in Asia.
description: Fairbanc is an Asia-based fintech (with primary operations in Indonesia) that lets unbanked and underserved micro, small, and medium-sized business owners buy inventory on a Buy Now, Pay Later basis, using a proprietary AI-powered credit-scoring platform to distribute microcredit quickly. Partnering with fast-moving consumer goods companies and their distributor and retailer networks, it has onboarded 350,000+ merchants and extended microcredit to 75,000+ MSMEs, with a focus on financial inclusion for women-operated and climate-vulnerable businesses. Founded by Mir Haque, a Wharton MBA alum (WG'08); backed by ADB Ventures.
